dataset: Complete COCO 2017 validation: 5000 images; instances and person keypoints annotations
reference: Locked YOLOv8n and YOLOv8n-pose checkpoints, Ultralytics 8.4.175, PyTorch 2.9.1 CPU FP32
candidate: Installed pinned yolo_ros core, existing ORT 1.28 TensorRT FP32/TF32 cache, native preprocessing and published 2D outputs

metrics.primary_reference_keypoints: Keep all reference coordinates and scores, exposing losses caused by the native publication filter
metrics.secondary_reference_keypoints: Also report reference with keypoints below0.5 set tozero; diagnostic decomposition only

evaluation: pycocotools2.0.11 standard COCOeval maxDets and IoU/OKS thresholds; same ordered images for all backends
failure_policy: No missing images or silent skips; preserve all primary failures. Do not substitute the policy-matched secondary reference to pass the primary threshold.
service_lifecycle: Stop managed detector/pose during sequential offline evaluation; other backends stay resident; restore in finally and verify health. Record engine hashes before and after.
scope: Public full-corpus deployment regression, not independent recorded scenes, tracking/gesture quality, visual question answering, real-time performance or whole JT-07 acceptance. Pretrained models may already have been evaluated on this public validation corpus.
